substantiveFindings: Verified all four input blobs at staging 7cdf8f42 and in the working tree (extraction 48,277 bytes). Pinned validators pass. The date receipt (2026-09-23) is hash-current and research-blocked. Its one finding holds 43 claims and 9 hints for undated ruler actions inflated to full reigns, imported points, a post-accession sequence encoded as an interval, undated allusions, and later reception or cache references assigned as activity.

Read all 81 units (Treatise on Food and Goods, part 2) in both English fields. The four accepted editorial decisions and their applied repairs (s0006 Song to the south, s0067 Dashi Linya, s0015 Huayan) are preserved verbatim; the new s0006 repair builds on r0001 and does not reverse it.

English: 15 definite field repairs across 8 units. 羊城 is Yangcheng, not the "Sheep/Yang Market" (s0002; also the claim-61 place). 禺中 is mid-morning, not the Wei hour (s0005). s0006 has three trading partners (Song, the northwestern tribes, Korea), not "the northwestern tribes of Song", and the pelts are grey squirrel and sable plus glue-fish skins, not "blue mice/voles". 南北府 are the Southern and Northern Divisions, not palaces (s0009). Also: a garbled 括富人馬不加多 (s0053 literal), the misspelling Wuduwann (s0055), the understated 十才一二 (s0075 idiomatic), and "timely" for 時災 (s0079 literal).

Chronology: every held item has a concrete cause and an item-by-item native treatment. Taizu's undated acts are not bounded by his imperial reign: the chapter places his yilijin tenure and inherited coinage before the founding (s0031, s0050), and the extracted 916-926 interval starts at the Shence era rather than his accession. These, together with his accession (及即位, which the annals put in AD 907, not 916) and the post-accession Hedong campaign, become native undated attestations. Taizu has no dated attestation left, so his hints become [].

Concrete errors and conflicts. Yelü Xiezhen (s0052) is a separate sentence wrongly placed in Taizu's reign; it becomes undated. Claim-123 is removed: s0039's 至清寧中 is an institutional fact about coin use decades after Shengzong's death. Liu Shouguang's cache (s0035) is provenance, not his dated activity. The source's 神冊初 date for the fall of Bohai conflicts with the Basic Annals (Tianzan 5, 926); the conflict is preserved explicitly, with the source wording and no Western year.

Source-supported bounds that are kept or narrowed. 會同初 becomes the Huitong era span AD 938-947, not a point. The Taiping coins date Shengzong's Da'an Mountain act to Taiping AD 1021-1031 (by the s0041 era-naming rule). 至末年 becomes Tianzuo's reign AD 1101-1125, not 1115-1125. s0010 (whose sourceDate 統和間 is not in the unit) becomes bounds AD 984-1005 from the chapter's dated sequence. The historian's period "from Taizu through Xingzong" and the Mencius quotation are not activity; they become undated with empty hints.

Identity and mentions: no missing people or mentions and no wrong event subjects among the 17 records. The English repairs need the claim-61 place update, a chained applied translation-repair record continuing the accepted r0001 (the native chain rule requires one when s0006 literal changes again), and mechanical preflight reconciliation (3 gone, 2 new candidates). No surface spans change.

The fully combined candidate passes the native extraction validator in memory, after the native input refresh, the date proposal, the English repairs and the edits above, with no chronology geometry errors. definiteTranslationRepairs.chinese: 東平郡城中置看樓，分南、北市，禺中交易市北，午漏下交易市南。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: In the seat of Dongping Commandery a lookout tower was erected, dividing South and North markets; at the center of the Wei hour trading was in the North Market, after the midday clepsydra mark trading was in the South Market.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: In the seat of Dongping Commandery a lookout tower was erected, dividing South and North markets; at mid-morning (the yuzhong hour) trading was in the North Market, after the midday clepsydra mark trading was in the South Market.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 禺中 is the si hour of mid-morning (about 9-11 a.m.); the Wei hour (未) is early afternoon, about 1-3 p.m. The northern market traded in the mid-morning and the southern market after the noon water-clock mark (午漏下). The idiomatic field gives the right clock time but under the wrong hour name.

definiteTranslationRepairs.chinese: 雄州、高昌、渤海亦立互市，以通南宋西北諸部、高麗之貨，故女直以金、帛、布、蜜、蠟諸藥材，及鐵離、靺鞨、於厥等部以蛤珠、青鼠、貂鼠、膠魚之皮、牛羊駝馬、毳罽等物，來易於遼者，道路繦屬。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Xiong, Gaochang, and Bohai also established mutual markets to connect goods from the northwestern tribes of Song to the south and from Korea; therefore the Jurchen brought gold, silk, cloth, honey, wax, and various medicinals, and the Tieli, Mohe, Yujue, and other tribes brought clam pearls, blue mice, sable mice, fish glue skins, oxen, sheep, camels, horses, felt rugs, and such things to trade with Liao—the roads were continuous with traders.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Xiong, Gaochang, and Bohai also established mutual markets to connect the goods of Song to the south, of the northwestern tribes, and of Korea; therefore the Jurchen brought gold, silk, cloth, honey, wax, and various medicinals, and the Tieli, Mohe, Yujue, and other tribes brought clam pearls, blue mice, sable mice, fish glue skins, oxen, sheep, camels, horses, felt rugs, and such things to trade with Liao—the roads were continuous with traders.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 以通南宋西北諸部、高麗之貨 lists three trading partners: Song to the south (南宋, the accepted repair r0001), the northwestern tribes (西北諸部) and Korea (高麗). The current English makes the northwestern tribes belong to Song. This builds on the accepted r0001 wording and does not reverse it.

definiteTranslationRepairs.chinese: 明年，詔以南、北府市場人少，宜率當部車百乘赴集。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: The next year, an edict stated that because the South and North Palace markets had few people, the appropriate tribes should be led with a hundred cart loads each to assemble there.

definiteTranslationRepairs.chinese: 當時括富人馬不加多，賜大、小鶻軍萬餘匹不加少，蓋畜牧有法然也。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: At that time when rich men's horses were inventoried they were not increased beyond count, and when more than ten thousand were bestowed on the Great and Small Hawk Armies they were not diminished—probably because herding had method.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: At that time, requisitioning rich men's horses did not add to the herds, and when more than ten thousand were bestowed on the Great and Small Hawk Armies they were not diminished—probably because herding had method.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 括富人馬不加多 means requisitioning the horses of the rich did not noticeably enlarge the herds, which pairs with 賜...不加少 (the grant of more than ten thousand did not diminish them). "Not increased beyond count" is invented and garbles the parallel. The idiomatic field already has the sense.

definiteTranslationRepairs.chinese: 西北之通舟楫，比之東南，十才一二。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Waterborne commerce in the northwest amounted to perhaps a tenth of that in the southeast.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Waterborne commerce in the northwest amounted to only one or two tenths of that in the southeast.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 十才一二 is "only one or two in ten". "Perhaps a tenth" understates the figure and drops the restrictive 才 ("only"). The literal field is correct.

definiteTranslationRepairs.chinese: 人力茍至，一夫猶足以勝時災，況為國乎！
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: If human effort is brought to completion, even one man is sufficient to overcome timely disasters—how much more for a state!
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: If human effort is brought to completion, even one man is sufficient to overcome seasonal disasters—how much more for a state!
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 時災 are seasonal or natural calamities; "timely" means opportune, the opposite sense. The idiomatic field has "seasonal disaster".

dateAuditReceipt.summary: Complete independent review of all 81 Chinese units, 100 temporal/hint checks, and 17 people. Explicit regnal-year and period contexts are supported. No source or canonical extraction was changed.
